title: Mother/Donor Plant Management & Plant Identity
level: Propagation & Clean Stock Specialist / advanced specialization development
intendedAudience: Learners progressing through the Propagation & Clean Stock Specialist pathway
Cultivation personnel responsible for mother/donor stock identity, health status, propagation sourcing and stock-area biosecurity
prerequisites: COURSE-LH-PCS-001 or approved equivalent seed/propagation foundation
Cultivation Technician II propagation troubleshooting competency or approved equivalent
evidencePolicy: Cannabis-specific propagation and plant-health literature supports donor identity, clonal propagation and stock-plant disease-risk concepts. A visually healthy stock plant is not assumed pathogen-free. Testing, release and sanitation procedures remain controlled by validated facility methods and applicable law.
assessmentPolicy: The dedicated specialist assessment is development-only until technical/assessment review, accessibility review and pilot evidence are complete. Course completion does not authorize diagnosis, pesticide decisions, destruction/disposition or release of held stock outside assigned authority.
description: Develops specialist management of mother/donor plants through accession identity, genealogy, suitability criteria, stock-area biosecurity, donor-linked performance analysis, testing status, longitudinal records and documented replacement decisions.
learningOutcomes: Establish and maintain reconstructable donor identity and genealogy from accession through cutting collection and downstream batch assignment.
Evaluate donor suitability using source identity, developmental condition, plant-health evidence, propagation performance history and defined acceptance criteria.
Apply stock-area biosecurity boundaries that separate clean, incoming, suspect and held donor material while preserving tool, personnel and movement controls.
Analyze donor-linked propagation performance without confusing correlation, genotype effects, plant condition and shared process/environment effects.
Design a donor lifecycle and replacement record that preserves provenance, testing status, performance trend, exceptions and disposition decisions without unsupported clean-stock claims.
